in_marathi.name: Nidhisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of treasures
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nidhisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nidhisha is the goddess of treasures and wealth in Hindu mythology. She is believed to protect and bestow wealth and prosperity on her devotees.
